title: Prince George young-forest patch distribution
method: Use the merge stages and young ages in the 2004 order record's 2005 implementation policy. patch-class-away: whether any class's absolute distance to its Table 7 target grew. distance-growth: the four classes' absolute distances to their targets added, in percentage points of young forest, at the end of the interval minus at its start.
missing: Unknown for missing periods, empty denominators or unresolved size classes.
